title: Newmark Arranges $38 Million Construction Financing for Camp Margaritaville in Brunswick, GA
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged $38 million in construction financing on behalf of South Street Partners and Brighton Real Estate Ventures to advance Camp Margaritaville Resort Golden Isles.
